newsitem.title: JAPAN: LTCB Feb debenture coupon seen at 1.9 pct - bankers.
newsitem.headline: LTCB Feb debenture coupon seen at 1.9 pct - bankers.

text.p: The coupon rate of the Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd's debentures for February is likely to be set at 1.9 percent, up from 1.8 percent the previous month, officials at long-term credit banks said.
But the officials said the LTCB is likely to leave its long-term prime lending rate unchanged at a record low of 2.5 percent in February from the previous month.
The LTCB has said it will announce the terms of the February debentures and its long-term prime rate for February at 2 p.m. (0500 GMT).
An expected rise in the new coupon rate reflected a widening spread between the market yields of the LTCB"s debentures and the Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd"s debentures, bond traders said.
The IBJ"s debenture is the benchmark in the market.
The market yield of the LTCB"s 1.8 percent January debenture, a key factor for the bank when it sets the terms of its February five-year debenture, rose to 1.95 percent on Wednesday.
The IBJ said on Wednesday that it would leave its February long-term prime lending rate unchanged at 2.5 percent from the previous month.
The coupon rate of the IBJ"s February debenture was set at 1.6 percent, unchanged from the January debenture.
